summary: Talos Energy's indirect subsidiary Talos Ocho Energy closed its previously announced acquisition of Gulf of America Outer Continental Shelf assets from Shell Offshore, alongside co-buyer Ridgewood Energy affiliate RE Fund V Holdco II Infrastructure. The unadjusted aggregate cash price was $1,700 million, with Talos Ocho's net closing consideration $420 million, including a $42.5 million prior escrow deposit. Talos Ocho acquired a 50% working interest and operatorship of Coulomb and a 25% interest in BP-operated Na Kika and related fields, effective July 1, 2025. Watch integration, production, and leverage.
